A simpler first day for SFD facilitators

Clickable demo for Monday, Nov 9 · not live in Disco

WHY I'M PROPOSING THIS

Help every new facilitator get started on their own.

Today, a new facilitator pieces together their first steps from a Welcome page, a Start Here page and a separate onboarding course. This proposal brings everything they need to the first screen they see, so they can onboard themselves and walk into their first lesson ready.

WHAT CHANGES

  • One front door: Start Here sits right on For You.
  • Victoria's welcome video leads the way.
  • Each module opens with Before You Teach and the five steps.
  • Fewer pages to hunt for, fewer clicks to get started.

How I got here

1 · EMPATHIZEWalk their first day

I followed a new facilitator from sign-in to their first lesson and noted every place they could get stuck.

2 · DEFINEName the problem

Their first steps are two clicks from where they land, and onboarding is split across a course and two pages.

3 · IDEATEOne front door

Start Here on For You, a welcome video, and a simpler Module A page that opens with Before You Teach.

4 · PROTOTYPEMake it clickable

This demo, built from real Disco screens and a working copy of Module A.

5 · TESTYour turn

Click through each tour. Notice what feels easy and what feels confusing, and bring it to Monday.

Take the tours

Look for the aqua box and the "Click here" arrow on each screen. Victoria's video shows the current recording. If this is approved, I'll collaborate with Victoria to quickly create a new onboarding video to replace it.
